input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: Section 14 matches our preferred position. 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor (and no transfer of rights); 14.2 gives Customer ownership of Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment and personnel assignments; 14.3 leaves Vendor its pre-existing Vendor Technology but applies the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence in 13.2 to any Vendor Technology embedded in or required to use a Deliverable; 14.4 blocks joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves our unrestricted right to use our own feedback. The definitions do not shrink what we own — "Deliverable" (1.4) excludes only Vendor Technology and unaided know-how, and "Vendor Technology" (1.8) expressly excludes Customer Data and pre-existing Customer IP — and 15.1 bars Vendor from selling Customer Data, using it for advertising, combining it with other customers' identifiable data, or training a generally available model on it without our written consent. No assignment of our IP or data to Vendor appears anywhere in the document. No redline needed.
